<center>
{| border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0"
|-
| valign="TOP" | <p align="LEFT">'''Lojban grammar examples'''</p>
|}
</center>

<center>
{| border="1" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0"
|-
| colspan="3" valign="TOP" | <p align="CENTER">'''"VERB"''' '''FORMS'''</p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT">DA DONSU
da dunda de
da dunda de di</p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="LEFT">HE GIVES.
HE GIVES IT.
HE, GIVES IT TO HIM.</p>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT">da se dunda
ETC.</p>
| <br />
| <p align="LEFT">IT IS A GIFT.</p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT">da te dunda
ETC.</p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="LEFT">HE IS A RECIPIENT.</p>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT">da ca dunda
da pu dunda
da ba dunda</p>
| <br />
| <p align="LEFT">HE NOW GIVES.
HE GAVE.
HE WILL GIVE,</p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT">da pu pu dunda
da ba pu dunda
</p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="LEFT">HE HAD GIVEN.
HE WILL HAVE GIVEN.</p>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT">da ca ca'o dunda</p>
| <br />
| <p align="LEFT">HE IS NOW GIVING.</p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT">da pu ca'o dunda</p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="LEFT">HE HAS BEEN GIVING.</p>
|}
</center>

<center>
{| border="0" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0"
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="LEFT">'''Lojban GRAMMAR''' derives great flexibility and variety from manipulation of [[cmavo|tense particles]] that do much of its work. As demonstrated here, it is the particles that determine whether a predicate—a term of extralinguistic reference, such as '''dunda''' and '''bajra'''—is to serve in a given statement as a noun, verb, adjective or adverb, as in more familiar grammars. Thus '''pu'''(''before''), '''ca''' (''now'') and '''ba''' (''after'') give the predicate '''dunda''' (''to give'') the function of a verb  (upper left)  and "conjugate" it through the future, present and past tense. Compound forms of these operators yield the compound tenses;</p>
| <br />
| <p align="LEFT">for example, '''pu pu''' (''before-before'') indicates the pluperfect tense. In such combinations they not only duplicate all of the familiar grammatical forms but go far beyond to express relationships that can be only clumsily approximated in the natural languages, as is indicated by the translation of the compound operator '''ba zi ze'u''' at center left. The flexibility of the system is suggested further by the transformations of '''dunda''' (in this table ''give'', ''giver'', ''gift'', ''generous'', ''generously'', ''generosity'', and so on) in accord with its association with operators and connectives or its place in a multiple predicate.</p>
|}
</center>

<center>
{| border="1" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0"
|-
| colspan="3" valign="TOP" | <p align="CENTER">''''''<font color="#000000">"</font>'''<font color="#000000">ADVERB"</font>'''<font color="#000000"> '''FORMS'''</font></p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">da ro roi dunda
da so'e roi dunda
da so'o roi dunda
ETC.</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">HE ALWAYS GIVES. 
HE USUALLY GIVES. 
HE SOMETIMES GIVES.</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">da pu zi dunda
da pu zu dunda
da ba zi dunda
</font></p>
| <br />
| <font color="#000000">HE RECENTLY GAVE. 
HE GAVE LONG AGO. 
HE WILL SOON GIVE.</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">da vi dunda
da va dunda
da vu dunda</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">HE GIVES HERE. 
HE GIVES THERE. 
HE GIVES OVER THERE.</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">da bu'u ro de dunda
</font></p>
| <br />
| <font color="#000000">HE GIVES EVERYWHERE (IN ALL PLACES).</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">da ba zi ze'u vi dunda
</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">SOON HE WILL BE GIVING HERE FOR A LONG TIME.</font>
|}
</center>

<center>
{| border="1" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0"
|-
| colspan="3" valign="TOP" | <p align="CENTER">'''NEGATIVES'''</p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">da na ku dunda

na ku da dunda

no da dunda</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">HE DOESN'T GIVE.
THERE ISN'T SO THAT ANYONE GIVES, 
NONE OF THEM GIVES.</font>
|}
</center>

<center>
{| border="1" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0"
|-
| colspan="3" valign="TOP" | <p align="CENTER">''''''<font color="#000000">"</font>'''<font color="#000000"> NOUN'''<font color="#000000">"</font>'''<font color="#000000"> </font>FORMS</font>'''</p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">lo remna
lo vi remna
lo va remna</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">A HUMAN 
THIS MAN 
THAT MAN</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">lo ro remna
lo so'e remna
lo so'i remna</font></p>
| <br />
| <font color="#000000">ALL MEN 
MOST MEN 
MANY MEN</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">no lo remna
lo pa remna
lo re remna</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">NONE OF THE MEN 
A MAN, ONE MAN 
TWO MEN</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">ro lo ci remna
</font></p>
| <br />
| <font color="#000000">ALL OF THE THREE MEN</font>
|}
</center>

<center>
{| border="1" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0"
|-
| colspan="3" valign="TOP" | <p align="CENTER">'''ABSTRACT '''<font color="#000000">"</font>'''NOUNS'''<font color="#000000">"</font>''''''''''''</p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">lo nu dunda
lo nu bajra</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">THE GIVING 
THE RUN</font>
|}
</center>

<center>
{| border="1" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0"
|-
| colspan="3" valign="TOP" | <p align="CENTER"><font color="#000000">'''"ADJECTIVE" FORMS'''</font></p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">lo laldo remna
lo dunda remna</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">AN OLD MAN
A GIVING MAN</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">lo melbi verba zdani
lo verba melbi zdani</font></p>
| <br />
| <font color="#000000">A PRETTY-CHILD HOME
A CHILDISHLY PRETTY HOME</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">lo remna poi laldo
lo remna poi na'o dunda
lo remna poi na'o dunda gi'e laldo</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">A MAN WHO IS OLD 
A MAN WHO IS GENEROUS 
A MAN WHO IS GENEROUS AND OLD</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">lo remna poi dunda de
lo remna poi dunda de di</font></p>
| <br />
| <font color="#000000">A MAN WHO GIVES IT
A MAN WHO GIVES IT TO HIM</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">lo laldo remna poi pu dunda ci de lo ze vi bajra</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">THE OLD MAN WHO GAVE THREE OF THEM TO THESE SEVEN RUNNERS</font>
|}
</center>

<center>
{| border="1" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0"
|-
| colspan="3" valign="TOP" | <p align="CENTER"><font color="#000000">'''IDENTITIES'''</font></p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">da du la djon
da du lo remna
da du lo laldo remna poi pu dunda ci de  lo ze vi remna</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">HE IS JOHN. 
HE IS THE MAN. 
HE IS THE OLD MAN WHO GAVE THREE OF THEM TO THESE SEVEN RUNNERS.</font>
|}
</center>

<center>
{| border="1" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0"
|-
| colspan="3" valign="TOP" | <p align="CENTER"><font color="#000000">'''COMPOUND FORMS'''</font></p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">da bajra gi'a cadzu
da bajra gi'e cadzu</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">HE RUNS OR WALKS. 
HE RUNS AND WALKS.</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">da a de bajra
da e de bajra</font></p>
| <br />
| <font color="#000000">HE1 OR HE2 RUNS. 
HE1 AND HE2 RUNS</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">DA PRANO O DE DZORU 
DA PRANO I DE DZORU 
DA PRANO U DE DZORU 
DA PRANO A DE DZORU</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">HE1 RUNS OR HE2 WALKS. 
HE1 RUNS AND HE2 WALKS, 
IF HE1 RUNS THEN HE2 WALKS. 
HE1 RUNS IF AND ONLY IF HE2 WALKS</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">DA PRANO BO DE DZORU 
DA PRANO LO DE DZORU 
ETC.</font></p>
| <br />
| <font color="#000000">HE1 RUNS BECAUSE HE2 WALKS. 
HE1 RUNS LIKE HE2 WALKS.</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">BO DE DZORU Kl DA PRANO 
ETC.</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">BECAUSE HE2 WALKS, HE1 RUNS.</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">DA PRANO NA DE DZORU 
DA PRANO PA DE DZORU 
DA PRANO VI DE DZORU 
ETC.</font></p>
| <br />
| <font color="#000000">HE1 RUNS WHEN HE2 WALKS. 
HE1 RUNS AFTER HE2 WALKS. 
HE1 RUNS WHERE HE2 WALKS,</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">NA DE DZORU Kl DA PRANO 
ETC.</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">WHEN HE2 WALKS HE1 RUNS.</font>
|}
</center>

<center>
{| border="1" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0"
|-
| colspan="3" valign="TOP" | <p align="CENTER"><font color="#000000">'''UNIVERSALS'''</font></p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">RADAKU DA PRANO U DZORU
RANAKU DA PRANO NA DE DZORU RAVIKU DA PRANO VI DE DZORU RADARODEKU DA DONSU U DA DONSU DE</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">ANYONE WHO RUNS CAN WALK. 
HE1 RUNS WHENEVER HE2 WALKS, 
HE1 RUNS WHEREVER HE2 WALKS. EVERYONE WHO GIVES GIVES SOMETHING</font>
|}
</center>

<center>
{| border="1" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="0"
|-
| colspan="3" valign="TOP" | <p align="CENTER"><font color="#000000">'''ATTITUDINAL FORMS'''</font></p>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">UA DA PRANO 
UE DA PRANO 
Ul DA PRANO 
ETC.</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">WHAT! HE RUNS? [ANGER] 
WELL! SO HE RUNS. [SURPRISE] 
HOW NICE THAT HE RUNS! [PLEASURE]</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">El DA PRANO 
EA DA PRANO 
DA PRANO EA DE 
ETC,</font></p>
| <br />
| <font color="#000000">DOES HE RUN? 
WHO RUNS? 
WHERE DOES HE RUN?</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">IA DA PRANO 
IE DA PRANO 
II DA PRANO 
IA NO DA PRANO 
ETC.</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">YES; HE RUNS. 
HE PROBABLY RUNS, 
PERHAPS HE RUNS. 
NO; HE DOESNT RUN.</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">Al Ml FA PRANO 
AE Ml FA PRANO 
AO Ml FA PRANO 
Al NO Ml FA PRANO 
ETC.</font></p>
| <br />
| <font color="#000000">YES; I WILL RUN. 
I WANT TO RUN. 
I HOPE TO RUN, 
NO; I WON'T RUN.</font>
|- valign="TOP"
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <p align="RIGHT"><font color="#000000">OA Ml FA PRANO 
ETC.</font></p>
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <br />
| bgcolor="#ccffff" | <font color="#000000">I MUST RUN.</font>
|}
</center>
